learning_v2.note: No ACTIONABLE v2 context-aware segment was identified for a material confidence change; current FX facts and contemporaneous market context dominate.

predictions.mechanism: A fresh multi-year yuan high alongside a softer DXY is a mild USD-weakness impulse that can support dollar-denominated gold, but very high U.S. yields and elevated oil constrain conviction.
predictions.invalidation: DXY reverses sharply higher or U.S. yield expectations reprice upward enough to overwhelm the currency impulse.

predictions.mechanism: Dollar softness is mildly supportive for silver, while stronger Asian currency sentiment may help the industrial-demand narrative, though high yields and oil keep the signal low-conviction.
predictions.invalidation: The dollar rebounds materially, yields rise further, or broader risk sentiment weakens enough to pressure industrial metals.
